# Auto-Generated Compiled Flows

This directory contains auto-generated code compiled from flow examples in the parent directory.

**DO NOT EDIT FILES IN THIS DIRECTORY MANUALLY**

All files here are generated by the Flow DSL compiler and will be overwritten.
To make changes, edit the corresponding `.py` file in the parent directory and recompile.

## Structure

```
examples/flows/
  nested_if.py              # Flow source
  if_else_simple.py         # Flow source
  compiled/
    nested_if/              # Compiled output for nested_if.py
      compiled_routers.py
      flow.png
      flow.dot
    if_else_simple/         # Compiled output for if_else_simple.py
      compiled_routers.py
      flow.png
      flow.dot
```

Each subdirectory contains:
- `compiled_routers.py` - Compiled router functions for Kubernetes deployment
- `flow.png` - Visual flow diagram
- `flow.dot` - Graphviz DOT source for the diagram
